senses.gloss: rapidity, (cmp. שגר) rapid review in recalling a tradition.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 130b:6">Sabb. 130ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא אגב שִׁיטְפָךְ רהיט וכ׳</he> perhaps in the rapidity of reviewing, the tradition came back to thy mind?; <he>אין אגב ש׳ רהיטא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="U00887"><he>שִׁיטְפָאִי</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) yes, my tradition was recalled by the (my) rapid review; <cite ref="Niddah 53b:35">Nidd. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>אגב שטפך אתיא לך</he>; <he>אגב שטפאי אתיא לי</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:1:5">Y. Sabb. XIX, beg. 16ᵈ</cite> <he>כד תחמון ש׳ עבר וכ׳</he> when you see the crowd pass by, bring them (the keys) by way of the row (the lines of men forming a partition for Sabbath purposes).

senses.gloss: [sweeping away, cmp. נסח, נסע,] discarding from the mind, forgetfulness.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81:2">Gen. R. s. 81</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01231"><he>עָקַת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 135:2">Yalk. ib. 135</cite> <cite ref="U00738"><he>שִׁטּוּפָא</he></cite>; Tanḥ. Vayishl. 8 <cite ref="U01458"><he>שמטי</he></cite>.
Lev. R. s. 15 (ref. to Job XXXVIII, 25) אית אתרין … שי׳ there are places where they call the hair shiṭfa; Yalk. ib. 554 שִׁיטְפָה.
